verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents an official CLI, but it ships as part of the Ruby gem ('Command Line Interface for various Honeybadger-related programs and utilities'). The only command evidenced is `honeybadger deploy` for deployment notifications, so it is a Ruby-tied utility rather than a general-purpose agent-friendly CLI. Missing for 10: a standalone language-agnostic CLI, evidence of commands for querying faults/Insights or managing projects, machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
